Pearl Residences is a residential development. The project also uses PPVC, a construction method designed to support more controlled production and quality checks. Are you looking at a home for your own stay or as an investment?
Probably for my own stay, but I’m just looking around for now. I work nearby, so the location and monthly cost would matter.

A visit could help you judge the setting and layout for yourself, alongside your usual route from work. If that would be useful, I can help arrange a viewing.
